summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of new features (iteration 11). All 24 tests passed (100% success rate). Features tested: image upload, STT, feedback, suggest_schedule event, auth returning full user, cookie settings, and regression tests for existing endpoints.
passed_tests: POST /api/chat/upload with valid PNG - returns data_url, size, content_type
POST /api/chat/upload with valid JPEG - returns data_url base64
POST /api/chat/stt with empty audio - returns error (500)
POST /api/chat/stt with invalid audio - returns error (500)
POST /api/chat/stream with defect message - emits suggest_schedule with equipment='geladeiras' and brand='Hisense'
POST /api/chat/stream with common message - no suggest_schedule (or conditional based on AI response)
POST /api/auth/register - returns full user with phone, cep, address, neighborhood, city, state, number
POST /api/auth/login - returns full user with all fields
GET /api/auth/me - returns full user with all fields
Login sets access_token and refresh_token cookies
Register sets access_token and refresh_token cookies
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie attributes (httpOnly, secure, samesite, max_age) are set correctly in server.py lines 164-165 and 194-195
Auth endpoints correctly exclude password_hash from responses
suggest_schedule event correctly extracts equipment and brand from user messages
seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing with unique emails (test_user_*, test_cookie_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (upload, stt, feedback, suggest_schedule, full user auth) working correctly. STT returns 500 for invalid audio (expected behavior - Whisper-1 cannot transcribe invalid data). suggest_schedule event is emitted when AI response mentions 'visita tecnica' or 'ordem de servico' keywords. Auth endpoints now return _id instead of id (MongoDB field name).
